# Elliot Lewis

> Elliot Lewis is a Staff Software Engineer at StubHub, based in Los Angeles, California. He's a front-end engineer with nearly a decade of building enterprise and consumer web apps, from factory-floor systems at Jabil to Lens creator tools at Snap.

He likes leading projects and teams, launching products people actually use, and leaving codebases easier to work in than he found them. His site is a single page styled like a hiking trail. Its hero photo doubles as a 3D game: press play, and a low-poly version of him cartwheels down a mountain, flattening trees and dodging bears.

Work history:

- StubHub, Los Angeles, CA: Staff Software Engineer (from Oct 2026), and Senior Software Engineer (Apr 2024 - Sep 2026).
- Snap Inc, Los Angeles, CA: Software Engineer (Aug 2021 - Feb 2024). Led Event Insights end to end across three teams, patented (US11894989B2) and launched at Snap Partner Summit 2022. Led a four-team effort to build an engagement-based monthly payout program for Lens creators, which drove Lens submissions up 300% in its first month. Cut My Lenses load times by about 40%, and grew end-to-end coverage of P0 test cases from 20% to 75%.
- Jabil, St Petersburg, FL: Senior Software Engineer (May 2019 - Aug 2021). The de facto front-end architect for 10+ teams, merging a fleet of on-prem front ends into a single regional cloud application. Led a team of 7 engineers redesigning every screen of a 450k+ line flagship application, and started Jabil's first inner-source project, an Angular component library.
- Jabil, Livingston, Scotland: Software Engineer (May 2017 - Sep 2018). Built an Angular UI package library used across every front end in iFactory, and partnered with a Microsoft team on an Angular front end for their ASP.NET Core API.

Skills: TypeScript, JavaScript, C# and SCSS; React, Angular, Tailwind, Panda CSS and Styled Components; GraphQL, gRPC, Node.js and .NET; Vite, Vitest, Playwright and Oxlint.

Education: Computer Science BSc (Hons), First Class Honours, Manchester Metropolitan University (Sep 2015 - May 2019), with a sandwich year and Academic Excellence awards in years 1 and 2.
